rationale: The trajectory reads d3 ^6.1.1 and then repeatedly records the 7.2.0 upgrade and installation as pending, without executing any edit or shell command. The verifier cannot find Jest, so it establishes an installation-state obstacle but not a d3 source defect or a failed dependency-upgrade operation. No timeout or explicit stopping decision is recorded, making no effective upgrade better supported than gave-up-or-budget; this relies on observed actions and version state, not an inference that the unavailable diff is empty.
